verdict.rationale: Proa is a component-based Rust web framework, so official component testing utilities are a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence documents a test harness for rendering components in isolation or simulating interaction. Build-time WCAG checks, `proa fmt --verify`, lint warnings and compile-time prop checking are adjacent validation features, not testing utilities.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official testing utilities to render and interact with components in isolation
